purpose: Replicates 4 and 5 extending the frozen PBA diagnostic series without changing any generation factor.

base_series.extension_changes: Replicate identifiers and output directory only

input.topic: Failure analysis and improvement strategies for synthesizing Prussian Blue Analogue (PBA) particles with cubic morphology

implementation.interpretation: Exact extension of the standardized three-run diagnostic series.

analysis_lock.analysis_text: Final moderator synthesis only; persona-generation text and debate turns are retained for audit but excluded from consensus coding.
analysis_lock.rank_rule: Record the moderator's highest-priority causal bottleneck as Rank 1 and retain up to two additional bottlenecks in stated priority order. Do not infer a Rank 1 from rhetorical emphasis if no priority is stated; code as mixed/unclear.
analysis_lock.five_run_consensus_rule: For each rank, report category counts and mean rank across all five runs. A stable primary bottleneck requires the same valid category at Rank 1 in at least three of five runs. Report both all-run and constraint-valid sensitivity results.
analysis_lock.claim_boundary: The five MPDS runs test diagnostic reproducibility. They do not prove causality or experimental reproducibility.
